searchText: So we're going for swan emoji (deneb) instead of brown bear emoji for great bear (dubhe)? Oh well, I guess we've done the panda-bear already. I only saw the dubhe suggestion after I posted that 🙂 I don’t mind, but some form of name would be nice 🙂 Easy to pronounce is a big win in my mind. But I seem to recall being promised no renames so we're going to have to skip D and just ship the eip4844 upgrade... 😛 I got nowhere in consensus-dev so will have to see what happens I guess It seems like an issue to have the label everywhere, and have to rename at some point, but also a blocker to keep as a pr, might be something to ponder after holidays… I could definitely see the rename never being done and having to remember eip4844 was in blah fork forever, is my concern
